brief: The 6 tools a solo founder uses to ship like a funded team — no hires, no investors, no excuses.

slots.subtitle: The six tools one founder uses to ship like a funded team without hiring anyone.
slots.preview1: How I ship features without writing every line
slots.preview2: The automation stack that replaces a virtual assistant
slots.preview3: Why design systems beat freelance hires every time

slots.title: Write code
slots.subtitle: An AI editor turns your specs into commits in minutes, not days.
slots.insight1Body: Cursor drafts CRUD routes while you review logic, cutting file time by half.
slots.insight2Body: Paste the stack trace and let the model trace dependencies across your entire repo.
slots.insight3Body: Rename a schema field and the AI updates types, queries, and tests instantly.
slots.pullQuote: I shipped a billing portal in an afternoon that used to take a week.

slots.title: Design systems
slots.subtitle: A reusable kit replaces the need for a full-time product designer early on.
slots.insight1Body: One button variant propagates across every mockup without manual redrawing.
slots.insight2Body: Clickable flows validate navigation logic with users before you touch a route file.
slots.insight3Body: Copy CSS values directly from frames and hand them to your build without translation.
slots.pullQuote: My product looks funded because the spacing grid never slips.

slots.title: Automate ops
slots.subtitle: Zaps and webhooks handle onboarding, alerts, and reporting while you stay heads-down.
slots.insight1Body: New sign-ups receive segmented emails and CRM tags without you lifting a finger.
slots.insight2Body: Pipe form submissions into a database and notify Slack in under ten minutes.
slots.insight3Body: Daily revenue summaries post to your inbox so you never miss a trend.
slots.pullQuote: I replaced three virtual assistant hours with a single webhook scenario.

slots.title: Explain once
slots.subtitle: Async screen recordings replace stand-ups, spec docs, and endless feedback threads.
slots.insight1Body: A two-minute walkthrough conveys edge cases faster than a thousand-word README.
slots.insight2Body: Stakeholders comment directly on the timeline instead of drafting reply-all emails.
slots.insight3Body: Record one bug fix and share the link with every user who reports the same issue.
slots.pullQuote: I cancelled every Monday meeting and reclaimed six hours of deep work.

slots.title: Run the company
slots.subtitle: Your wiki, roadmap, and CRM live in a single database-driven workspace.
slots.insight1Body: Link features to user feedback so priorities stay grounded in real pain points.
slots.insight2Body: Documented SOPs turn repetitive tasks into copy-paste checklists you never rethink.
slots.insight3Body: A simple rollup calculates MRR against burn and forecasts thirty days out.
slots.pullQuote: Investors ask for my Notion link before they ask for my cap table.

slots.title: Monetize fast
slots.subtitle: Stripe handles billing, tax, and invoicing so you can focus on product value.
slots.insight1Body: Copy a checkout snippet and start charging before you have an accountant.
slots.insight2Body: Stripe Tax calculates local rates and remits them across jurisdictions automatically.
slots.insight3Body: Branded receipts and customer portals make a solo shop feel like Salesforce.
slots.pullQuote: Revenue hit my account before I had time to panic about pricing pages.

slots.ctaBody: Ship like a funded team using Cursor, Figma, Zapier, Loom, Notion, and Stripe. No hires required.
